questions.stem: Which of the following is a method of asexual reproduction?
questions.solution: Budding is a method of asexual reproduction where a new organism develops from a bud-like projection on the parent. Fertilisation and gamete formation involve the combination of genetic material from two parents, which is characteristic of sexual reproduction. Sexual reproduction itself is not a method of asexual reproduction. Therefore, the correct answer is budding.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी अलैंगिक प्रजनन की विधि है?
hi.solution: बुद्धिमता अलैंगिक प्रजनन की विधि है जिसमें एक नए जीव का विकास माता-पिता पर एक बुद्धि जैसे उभरे हुए भाग से होता है। निषेचन और गैमीट का निर्माण दोनों माता-पिता के आनुवंशिक सामग्री के संयोजन के साथ जुड़े हुए हैं, जो लैंगिक प्रजनन की विशेषता है। लैंगिक प्रजनन स्वयं अलैंगिक प्रजनन की विधि नहीं है। इसलिए सही उत्तर बुद्धिमता है।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning, with appropriate scientific terminology used in Indian textbooks.

mr.stem: खालीलपैकी कोणते अलैंगिक प्रजोत्पादनाचे पद्धत आहे?
mr.solution: बुदिंग ही अलैंगिक प्रजोत्पादनाची पद्धत आहे जेथे जनकावरून एक बुदिंग आकाराच्या उत्पादनातून नवीन जीव विकसित होतो. परागकोशिका निर्मिती आणि गॅमीट निर्मिती दोन जनकांच्या जीनेटिक सामग्रीच्या संयोजनाशी संबंधित असतात, जे लैंगिक प्रजोत्पादनाची वैशिष्ट्य आहे. लैंगिक प्रजोत्पादन स्वतः अलैंगिक प्रजोत्पादनाचे पद्धत नाही. त्यामुळे योग्य उत्तर बुदिंग आहे.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the original meaning. Technical terms like 'बुदिंग' (budding), 'गॅमीट निर्मिती' (gamete formation), and 'लैंगिक प्रजोत्पादन' (sexual reproduction) are correctly used in Marathi science textbooks.

questions.stem: Which part of the female reproductive system is a bag-like structure where a foetus develops?
questions.solution: The uterus is a bag-like structure where a foetus develops, as it provides a protective environment for the growing baby. The fallopian tube is a narrow passageway that transports the egg, the cervix is a muscular canal connecting the uterus to the vagina, and the vagina is the external opening of the reproductive system.

hi.solution: गर्भाशय एक थैली जैसी संरचना है जहां भ्रूण विकसित होता है, क्योंकि यह बच्चे के विकास के लिए एक सुरक्षित वातावरण प्रदान करता है। फैलोपियन नलिका अंडे के परिवहन के लिए एक संकीर्ण पासाज है, गर्भाशय ग्रीवा गर्भाशय को जननांग से जोड़ने वाली मांसपेशी नाली है और जननांग जनन प्रणाली का बाहरी खंड है।

questions.stem: Which process is ensured when a flower’s anthers are removed before it matures and pollen from another plant is dusted on its stigma?
questions.solution: Cross-pollination is ensured because pollen from another plant is transferred to the stigma. This process involves the movement of pollen between different plants, unlike self-pollination, which uses pollen from the same flower. Fertilisation occurs after pollination and is not the process of pollen transfer itself. Tissue culture is unrelated to pollen movement.

hi.stem: जब एक पुष्प के एनर्थ्स को परिपक्व होने से पहले हटा दिया जाता है और दूसरे पौधे के पराग को इसके वर्तिकाग्र पर छिड़क दिया जाता है, तो कौन-सी प्रक्रिया सुनिश्चित की जाती है?
hi.solution: अंतःपरागण सुनिश्चित किया जाता है क्योंकि दूसरे पौधे के पराग को वर्तिकाग्र पर स्थानांतरित किया जाता है। इस प्रक्रिया में विभिन्न पौधों के बीच पराग के गतिशीलता शामिल होती है, जबकि स्व-परागण में एक ही पुष्प के पराग का उपयोग किया जाता है। निषेचन परागण के बाद होता है और पराग के स्थानांतरण की प्रक्रिया नहीं है। ऊतक संवर्धन पराग के गतिशीलता से संबंधित नहीं है।
hi.critique: Hindi translation accurately reflects the English original in meaning, terminology, and structure. All technical terms are standard in Hindi biology textbooks.

mr.stem: एका फुलाच्या अँथर्स त्याच्या परिपक्वतेपूर्वी काढल्यास आणि दुसऱ्या वनस्पतीच्या परागाने त्याच्या पुष्पास्त्रावर वारा घातल्यास कोणती प्रक्रिया खात्री बनवली जाते?

mr.critique: The translation is accurate and maintains the scientific terminology used in Marathi textbooks.

questions.stem: Why does the menstrual cycle stop during pregnancy?
choices: Because the body stops producing hormones
Because the uterus is no longer able to support the cycle
Because the fertilised egg attaches to the uterus wall
Because the body focuses on supporting the embryo
questions.solution: During pregnancy, the body focuses on supporting the embryo, which leads to the cessation of the menstrual cycle. The other options are incorrect because the body continues to produce hormones, the uterus remains capable of supporting the cycle, and the attachment of the fertilized egg does not directly stop the cycle.

questions.stem: What is the main reason human babies are completely dependent on adults for a long time compared to many animals?
choices: They have a lower intelligence level
They need more time to learn social behaviors
Their body systems are not fully developed at birth
They are born with a higher intelligence level
questions.solution: Human babies are born with underdeveloped body systems, which require time to mature, making them dependent on adults for care and nutrition. This is a biological fact supported by developmental science. The other options are incorrect because intelligence level and social learning are not the primary reasons for their dependency at birth.

questions.stem: In which of the following ways is the reproduction in yeast similar to that in hydra?
choices: Both form buds that detach from the parent
Both require a moist environment for growth
Both involve the formation of a sac-like structure
questions.solution: The correct answer is 'Both form buds that detach from the parent'. In both yeast and hydra, reproduction occurs through budding, where a small outgrowth called a bud forms on the parent and eventually detaches to live independently. The other options are incorrect because yeast does not reproduce by spores, it does not involve a sac-like structure, and while a moist environment is important, it is not a direct similarity in their reproductive methods.

questions.stem: In which of the following animals is fertilisation internal?
questions.solution: Birds undergo internal fertilisation, where the sperm meets the egg inside the female's body. Frogs and fish, as well as amphibians, typically have external fertilisation, where the egg and sperm are released into the environment. Therefore, the correct answer is bird.

questions.stem: In the case of animals with external fertilisation, what is the main reason for producing a large number of eggs?
choices: To ensure that enough eggs survive to adulthood
To provide food for other animals
To increase the chances of fertilisation
To allow for the development of larvae
questions.solution: The main reason for producing a large number of eggs in external fertilisation is to ensure that enough eggs survive to adulthood, as many are destroyed by environmental factors. The other options are either incorrect or not the primary reason.

questions.stem: Which type of reproduction ensures that the genetic information needed for the complete development of an individual is contained in a haploid set of chromosomes?
choices: Development of male honey bee from an egg
questions.solution: The development of a male honey bee from an egg is a form of reproduction where the individual develops from an unfertilized egg, and the genetic information is contained in a haploid set of chromosomes.
